Do you have what it takes to shine as a true forklift hero in the frozen food industry? 
Then we have the perfect challenging position for you! This company, located in Ardooie, is a global player in the development, processing, and marketing of fresh-frozen products such as vegetables, fruit, herbs, and ready-made meals. We need YOU to join our team! 
As a forklift driver working 2 shifts, you'll play a crucial role in our production process. Showcase your talents and embrace the following tasks with pride: 

 
• Confidently and expertly operate the forklift to load, unload, and move goods within the refreshing frozen food environment (-18 degrees Celsius). 
 
• Your precision and care ensure that products are stacked correctly and stored in their designated locations. 
 
• You'll perform warehouse activities with the utmost care, such as counting and checking goods and accurately recording data. 
 

 
• You're a true safety hero and actively contribute to maintaining our high safety standards and promoting a positive work environment. 
 
• You'll collaborate with great colleagues and other departments to ensure smooth production flows. 

Requirements for this adventurous forklift driver role: 

 
• You have a valid forklift certificate OR can demonstrate experience as a forklift driver. 
 

 
• Don't be afraid to brave the cold, as you'll be showcasing your forklift skills in a deep-freeze environment with temperatures down to -18°C. Your forklift cabin is heated! 
 

 
• Your eye for detail and accuracy make you the king/queen of precision work. 
 

 
• You're a true team player and communicate easily with your colleagues. 
 
• You speak fluent English and are willing to learn Dutch. The company offers Dutch lessons before or after your shift.

The company is recognized for its scientific expertise and commitment to supporting innovation across the drug development process. The client is based in Schaerbeek.

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.
 

You will work in a two-shift system:
 

 
• Early shift: 06:00–14:00
 
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00 
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.
 

Your tasks and responsibilities
 

 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
 
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.
 
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.
 
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.
 
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
 
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment. 

 
• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.
 
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.
 
• A good command of Dutch.
 
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
 
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
 
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager Industial & Technical Solutions
jobs.description:
HQ Antwerp | Coverage: Europe (with potential EMEA expansion)| Business Development Manager| Energy, Oil & Gas

About the Company
Our client is an international technology organization with a strong footprint across Europe. The company designs and delivers advanced software and hardware solutions for complex industrial environments in the oil & gas industry, helping customers operate safely, efficiently and in full regulatory compliance.
 

Your New Role 
As Business Development Manager, you are responsible for driving new business growth across Europe. You focus on opening new doors, building long-term commercial relationships and developing a sustainable opportunity pipeline within large, complex organizations. This is a pure new business role with a long-term perspective. You will work on strategic target accounts with lengthy investment cycles, where success depends on trust-building, market insight, and persistence rather than short-term wins. You work closely with the Sales Manager and internal technical teams and operate in a hybrid model combining office-based work, customer visits and international travel. Key Responsibilities
• Identify, approach and develop new customers and new opportunities across European markets
• Map target regions, industries and strategic accounts and define focused action plans
• Establish relationships with key decision-makers within complex organizations
• Build and manage a qualitative sales pipeline through continuous prospecting and follow-up
• Understand customer processes, strategic challenges and long-term investment roadmaps
• Prepare and deliver tailored presentations, demonstrations and commercial proposals
• Collaborate with internal engineering and solution teams to translate business needs into technical solutions
• Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events and conferences
• Maintain structured reporting and pipeline management through CRM tools
• Contribute to long-term growth strategy, forecasting and market development initiatives
 

Your Profile

• At least 3 years of experience in Business Development within a technical or industrial environment
• Educational background in engineering, industrial technology or IT, or equivalent technical-commercial experience
• Experience or affinity with industries such as energy, process industry, industrial systems or infrastructure is a plus
• Demonstrated ability to generate new business, open new accounts and build relationships from the ground up
• Strong hunter mentality with resilience and confidence in approaching senior stakeholders
• Comfortable operating in environments with long sales cycles and high-value investment projects
• Strong communication and presentation skills at executive and technical levels
• Languages: English and Dutch are mandatory; additional European languages (German or French) German is a plusWillingness to travel regularly (short, project-based trips)

About Us: Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027. 
 

Job Description & Key ResponsibilitiesAs a OPEX engineer you will drive the continuous improvement culture within the production facility. In this role you will look beyond the surface, diving deep into the process to eliminate waste and scale manufacturing efficiency to the next level.
 

We’re looking for an energetic and enthusiastic personality with excellent communication skills, capable of inspiring and engaging teams to bring meaningful change and challenge the status quo, while respecting strict quality and safety.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Process Optimization: you are responsible for identifying, implementing, and ensuring process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and safety. 

• Follow-up on KPI’s; apply value stream mapping and execute Gemba walks. 

• Based on data driven analysis, you identify hidden opportunities and propose improvements. 

• Lead independently cross functional improvement projects with minimal supervision. 

• Standardization & training: write, revise, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures to embed new best practices firmly into daily operations; deliver training modules to build a site-wide OPEX mindset. Responsible for keeping training matrix up-to-date and organizing training accordingly, in collaboration with the production team lead.  

• Identify root causes of technical anomalies/malfunctions or inefficiencies. 

• Provide support with day-to-day technical problems; act as a point of contact for problem solving. 

• Support implementation of new equipment, systems or workflows. 

The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, preventive way of thinking, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. 
 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A master’s degree in engineering/biotech with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a continuous Improvement or OPEX role within a manufacturing environment; 

• Proven track record of applying operational excellence techniques as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in a production setting. 

• Analytical and data-driven, out-of-the-box thinking, solution-oriented mindset, and a hands-on approach. 

• Experience in biochemical process know-how and change-management is a plus. 

• A structured way of working, with an eye of detail, excellent communicator able to engage people, with a drive for continuous improvement. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.

• As key person between external suppliers and our sales team, you are the end-to-end responsible for the product range :   

o You manage the contacts with external suppliers 
 

o Analyse, propose and manage the product portfolio 
 

o Develop and implement product pricing and positioning strategies 
 

o Decide on and manage the replenishment and stock levels of our Belgian warehouse 
 

o Act as technical expert and support of our sales team 
 
 

• As internal expert for this product range, act as a product evangelist to build technical expertise in our sales team  

• Drive product launches including working with our suppliers, our sales teams, and customers  

• Accompany our sales team at customers and fairs to solicit feedback on company products and services, explore new products and monitor competitors for this product line  

• Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth  

• Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners  

• Evaluate promotional plans to ensure that they are consistent with product line strategy  

• Support customer service for direct business and trade 
 

• Proven work experience in category and product management  

• Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle  

• Solid technical background  

• Strong problem solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job  

• Skilled at working effectively with cross functional teams and external suppliers  

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English / German / French)  

• Bachelor degree in Engineering or equivalent preferred
